描述_EN: ad1250- 1500. egyptian, mamluk ca. damask was produced in ancient china but took it’s name from damascus, syria, where it was produced for european export in the 12th century. a damask is a reversible fabric of silk (also wool, linen or cotton) with a pattern formed from one warp and one weft. the piece is roughly cut in a rectangle. ad1250-1500. often with large floral designs. the pattern is in a warp-faced, satin weave with the bnackground in weft-faced, sateen weave. on one side the selvage has been hemmed over with rough whip stitches using a light brown thread. a fragment of woven, blue, silk damask. some holes. a geometric pattern using diamonds is just visible on some of the fragment. length of 140mm and width of 85mm.
描述_ZN: AD1250-1500. 埃及的，大约是马姆鲁克的。 大马士革产于古代中国，但它的名字来自叙利亚的大马士革，12世纪时在那里为欧洲出口生产。 大马士革是一种可翻转的丝绸（也包括羊毛、亚麻或棉）织物，其图案由一根经线和一根纬线组成。 该片被粗略地切割成长方形。 广告1250-1500。 通常有大的花卉图案。 图案是经面的缎面织法，背景是纬面的纱布织法。 一边的边角料已经用浅棕色的线用粗糙的鞭子缝合了。 一块编织的蓝色丝绸大马士革的碎片。 有一些孔。 在一些碎片上可以看到一个使用钻石的几何图案。 长度为140mm，宽度为85mm。
